title: Puzzle 2d Canvas Text Labels Wrong
summary: Fixed puzzle 2d canvas text labels drifting away from nodes during pan, zoom, and drag. paintTextOverlays no longer skips repaints when wheelZoomGestureActive or defersDescriptorSyncFromJs — GPU kept updating while the overlay canvas stayed frozen. Added regression test paintTextOverlays repaints during wheel zoom and deferred descriptor sync. puzzle/2d/react vitest: 98 passed.
